dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Oh, boss, it's you. That guy Childe you sent me to find, he isn't too bad a guy.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: He gave me enough pay for several days of work, all the way until we're done with that ritual of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Honestly, he's way easier with his money than you are.
